origin: cwe/89/php Key Principles: Laravel orderByRaw() is a raw sink; identifiers and directions cannot be bound

finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command
finding.summary: The Laravel query builder binds values in where clauses, but a request-controlled sort string flows into orderByRaw().

trap: Adding bindings to whereRaw(), calling DB::raw($sort), or checking that range is one of month/year while leaving sort raw. The column and direction must come from a server-side allowlist, preferably using orderBy() with mapped column and direction values.
must_preserve: account_id remains constrained, range still maps to the existing 31-day or 365-day window, and approved sort modes continue to work without accepting arbitrary SQL text.
